intro.summary: North-central inner-city community north of 16 Avenue NW, where narrow-lot single-detached and semi-detached infills replace early 20th-century homes.
intro.body: Mount Pleasant is a North Hill community just north of 16 Avenue NW, bordering Confederation Park and a short walk from SAIT. Its grid of 25- and 50-foot lots has made it a long-running infill area. Older bungalows and character homes sit beside new two-storey single-detached and semi-detached builds.
